style: Warm, whimsical children's picture-book illustration. Bold, flat digital art with clean thick outlines, brightly saturated colors, cheerful sunny lighting. Friendly, rounded character design. Single clear scene, no text or watermarks, no panel borders.
characters: Leo: a boy about 7 years old with short curly brown hair, warm brown skin, wearing a green striped t-shirt and denim overalls.
cover: Leo kneeling happily in a garden next to a tall blooming yellow sunflower, holding a small watering can, bright blue sky behind him.
pages: Leo sitting at a wooden table in a sunny garden, holding a tiny seed packet in one hand and a small pot of dark soil in front of him, curious expression.
Leo kneeling in the garden, gently pressing a small seed into a pot of dark soil with his finger.
Leo watering the pot of soil with a small green watering can, a fine spray of water droplets catching the sunlight.
A small green sprout with two tiny leaves poking up out of the soil in the pot, Leo watching it closely with a big excited smile, magnifying glass in hand.
Leo standing proudly next to a tall, fully bloomed bright yellow sunflower much taller than him in the garden, arms raised in celebration.
